```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(tmap)
```

```{r}
ejscreen <- st_read('data/ejscreen/EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb')
mapineqlos <- st_read('data/mapping-inequality/mapping-inequality-los-angeles.json')
mpainqnew <- st_read('data/mapping-inequality/mapping-inequality-new-haven.json')
crashes <- st_read('data/SWITRS_LA/Crashes.csv')
```

# Part 1: Legacy of redlining in current environmental (in)justice

## Create a map of historical redlined neighborhoods

```{r}
# map of LA redlining
laejscreen <- ejscreen |> 
    filter(CNTY_NAME == 'Los Angeles County')



tm_shape(laejscreen)+
    tm_borders(lwd = 0.1)+
tm_layout(asp = 0) +
tm_shape(mapineqlos, is.main = TRUE) +
    tm_polygons(
        fill = 'grade',
        fill.scale = tm_scale_categorical(values = c('green','blue','yellow','red')),
        fill.legend = tm_legend('HLOC Grade', frame = FALSE, position = tm_pos_out('center','bottom','left'))
    )+
    tm_title(text = 'HOLC Ranking of Neighborhoods in LA') +
    tm_compass(type = 'radar', position = tm_pos_out('center','bottom','center'))+
    tm_scalebar(position = tm_pos_out('center','bottom','right'))
```

## Create table summarizing...

```{r}
# Check CRS's before spatially joining
st_crs(mapineqlos)
st_crs(ejscreen)

# convert CRS's and then spatial join
mapineqlos<- st_transform(mapineqlos, crs = st_crs(ejscreen))
ejxred <- st_join(mapineqlos, ejscreen)

# finding percent of blocks that are x Grade HOLC
gradeprop <- ejxred |> 
    st_drop_geometry() |> 
    select(c('grade','PM25','LOWINCPCT')) |> 
    count(grade)
gradeprop$n <- gradeprop$n/nrow(ejxred)
gradeprop

ggplot(gradeprop, aes(x = grade, y = n))+
    geom_bar(stat = 'identity')
```

```{r}
# Checking the map just made with a left join

tm_shape(ejxred)+
    tm_polygons(fill = 'grade')
```

```{r}
# checking the mpa of an inner join
innerjoin <- st_join(mapineqlos, ejscreen, left = FALSE)

tm_shape(innerjoin) +
    tm_polygons(fill = 'grade')
```

## Create two visualizations summarizing current conditions

```{r}
sumbygrade <- ejxred |> 
    group_by(grade) |> 
    summarise(meanlowinc = mean(LOWINCPCT), meanpm25 = mean(PM25), meanlowlifexpect = mean(LIFEEXPPCT, na.rm =TRUE))

ggplot(sumbygrade, aes(x = grade, y = meanlowinc))+
    geom_bar(stat ='identity')

ggplot(sumbygrade, aes(x = grade, y = meanpm25))+
    geom_bar(stat ='identity')

ggplot(sumbygrade, aes(x = grade, y = meanlowlifexpect))+
    geom_bar(stat ='identity')
```

# Part 2: Legacy of redlining in pedstrian and bike accidents

## Figure summarizing the percent of observations within redlined neighborhoods within each HOLC grade


```{r}
# Filter crash data to 2020-2025
accidentyearfilter <- crashes |> 
    filter(ACCIDENT_YEAR >= 2020)

# Check which columns have more NA's x/y or lat/long

sum((accidentyearfilter$POINT_X == 'NA'))  
sum((accidentyearfilter$LATITUDE == 'NA'))  

# Way more NAs in lat/lon, lets use x y instead

# Get ride of NA's in coordinates
accidentyearfilter <- accidentyearfilter |> 
    filter(POINT_X != 'NA')
# Convert character columns to geometries

accidentyearfilter <- st_as_sf(accidentyearfilter, coords = c('POINT_X', 'POINT_Y'), crs = 4326)
```

```{r}
# Joining accident df with HCOL in LA DF

# Check CRS's before spatially joining
st_crs(accidentyearfilter)
st_crs(mapineqlos)

# convert CRS's and then spatial join
accidentyearfilter<- st_transform(accidentyearfilter, crs = st_crs(mapineqlos))

# Join accidents with HCOL in LA
accxHCOL <- st_join(mapineqlos, accidentyearfilter)
```

```{r}
# Visualize proportion of pedestrian accidents and fatalities by HCOL Grade
proppedHCOL <- accxHCOL |> 
    st_drop_geometry() |> 
    filter(PEDESTRIAN_ACCIDENT == 'Y') |> 
    count(grade) 

proppedfata <- accxHCOL |> 
    st_drop_geometry() |> 
    filter(COUNT_PED_KILLED > 0) |> 
    count(grade)


proppedHCOL$propacc <- proppedHCOL$n/sum(accxHCOL$PEDESTRIAN_ACCIDENT == 'Y', na.rm = TRUE)
proppedHCOL$propfata <- proppedfata$n/sum(accxHCOL$COUNT_PED_KILLED > 0, na.rm =TRUE)

proppedHCOL <- pivot_longer(proppedHCOL, cols = c('propfata','propacc'), names_to = 'aorf', values_to = 'prop')

ggplot(proppedHCOL, aes(fill = aorf, x = grade, y = prop)) +
    geom_bar(position = 'dodge',stat = 'identity') +
    labs(title = 'Proportion of Pedestrian Accidents and Fatalities by HCOL Grade', x = 'HCOL Grade',y = 'Proportion', fill = 'Accident or Fatality') +
    scale_fill_discrete(labels = c('Pedestrian Accident','Pedestrian Fatalities'))
```

```{r}
# Visualize proportion of bicycle accidnets by HCOL Grade

propbikeHCOL <- accxHCOL |> 
    st_drop_geometry() |> 
    filter(BICYCLE_ACCIDENT == 'Y') |> 
    count(grade) 

propbikefata <- accxHCOL |> 
    st_drop_geometry() |> 
    filter(COUNT_BICYCLIST_KILLED > 0) |> 
    count(grade)


propbikeHCOL$propacc <- propbikeHCOL$n/sum(accxHCOL$BICYCLE_ACCIDENT == 'Y', na.rm = TRUE)

bikedeaths <- accxHCOL |> 
    group_by(grade) |> 
    filter(COUNT_BICYCLIST_KILLED > 0) |> 
    count(grade) |> 
    mutate(propdeath = n/sum(n))

propbikeHCOL <- left_join(propbikeHCOL, bikedeaths, by = 'grade')

propbikeHCOL <- pivot_longer(propbikeHCOL, cols = c('propdeath','propacc'), names_to = 'aorf', values_to = 'prop')

ggplot(propbikeHCOL, aes(fill = aorf, x = grade, y = prop)) +
    geom_bar(position = 'dodge',stat = 'identity') +
    labs(title = 'Proportion of Bicyclist Accidents and Fatalities by HCOL Grade', x = 'HCOL Grade',y = 'Proportion', fill = 'Accident or Fatality') +
    scale_fill_discrete(labels = c('Bicyclist Accident','Bicyclist Fatalities'))
```
